messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty PD:INC-2026-487 fired -> prometheus-scrape-fanout: exporter-throttle (429) in us-west-2, auto-escalation enabled. Links: https://pagerduty.example/INC-2026-487 :rotating_light:

alice: got the page, seeing repeated 429s from multiple node-exporter pods in us-west-2. Metrics show spike in scrape response time and 429 codes.

ben: @alice can you paste the exporter logs? suspecting rate-limiter on sidecar or nginx in front.

alice: pasted sample logs:
```
2026-03-15T14:02:11Z exporter[pid=23]: 429 Too Many Requests - /metrics?target=node01
2026-03-15T14:02:12Z exporter[pid=23]: 429 Too Many Requests - /metrics?target=node02
```

carla: confirmed from k8s svc metrics: 50% of scrape attempts returning 429 over the last 2m. k8s svc is fronted by envoy with per-host rate limits.

dave-oncall: acked the PD incident (PD incident #INC-2026-487) and oncall takeover. Tagging @emma-sre for follow-up.

pd-bot: PD:INC-2026-487 acknowledged by dave-oncall at 2026-03-15T14:03:05Z

emma-sre: quick mitigation plan: 1) temporarily increase scrape interval for affected targets 2) scale up scraper replicas 3) remove strict per-host envoy rate limit for scrape path. Do in that order.

ben: I can scale scraper now. Running: `kubectl -n monitoring scale deploy/prometheus-scraper --replicas=8`

alice: changing scrape config in prom configmap to bump interval from 15s -> 60s for node-exporter job (target group us-west-2). Pushing patch now, will reload prom.

carla: removing envoy rate-limit on path \/metrics for the exporter backend (temporary). Patch applied to envoy-configmap in us-west-2 canary.

dave-oncall: executing rollout for envoy in us-west-2: `kubectl -n infra rollout restart ds/envoy-daemonset-us-west-2` — watching for pod bounce.

alice: prom reload complete, new scrape interval in effect. Expecting scrape load drop within 1m.

ben: scraper scale successful, new pods in Running state. `kubectl get pods -n monitoring | grep scraper` shows 8 replicas.

carla: rate-limit removal propagated, initial traffic shows 429s dropping to <1% within 45s.

emma-sre: monitoring dashboards show backlog clearing. log ingestion pipeline shows <2m lag now vs 15m earlier.

dave-oncall: customer-impact check: dashboards for ~120 hosts in us-west-2 were stale for ~10-18m. No billing or event-loss, just telemetry delay. Flagging for customer comms if any external SLAs touched.

alice: opened follow-up ticket INFRA-2026-211 to root-cause (envoy rate limiting + scrape fanout). Assigned to @carla.

ben: adding a temporary alert suppression rule for the affected prom job so we don't re-page while we finish RCA. Will set expiry in 2h.

emma-sre: next steps: revert scrape interval to 15s after we roll a controlled, rate-limit-aware envoy config; implement per-scraper circuit breaker to avoid single-host overloading.

dave-oncall: marking PD incident resolved in PagerDuty (auto-resolve check OK). PD:INC-2026-487 resolved at 2026-03-15T14:07:50Z.

pd-bot: PD:INC-2026-487 resolved by dave-oncall - recorded timeline and actions.

carla: quick RCA notes to the ticket: sudden spike in concurrent scrape connections from central scraper pool -> envoy per-host rate limiter tripped -> 429 fanout -> prom backoff -> alerting. Root cause: config drift after infra change yesterday that lowered envoy rate-limit threshold.

alice: posting runbook tweaks to docs: add step to scale scrapers and to check envoy rate-limit on paged alerts.

emma-sre: nice work team. I'll schedule a post-incident review for tomorrow 10:00 UTC. Action items: INFRA-2026-211 (envoy config revert & safe rollout), INFRA-2026-212 (scraper autoscale tuning), DOCS-2026-17 (runbook update).

dave-oncall: closing thread here — if anything regresses ping this thread or reopen PD. :thumbsup:
